bio.paragraph1: I started out building WordPress sites and managing traditional hosting. Today I design and ship systems with applied AI.
bio.paragraph2: I work across the whole stack, but my job right now is RAG, MCP and MLOps over corporate data: databases nobody documented, scanned PDFs, spreadsheets with fifteen tabs.
bio.paragraph3: I also give talks on applied AI and data science, at conferences and universities.

work.description: Three companies and five roles, from intern to Applied AI Engineer.

appliedai.title: Applied AI Engineer
achievements: I bring AI into the team's internal processes and into the financial software the consultancy builds for its clients.

architect.title: AI Solutions Architect
achievements: Connie, from zero to production: I designed the RAG platform and wrote 80% of the system. Three of the consultancy's clients now use it daily.
End-to-end RAG pipelines on Azure: ingestion, chunking, retrieval and serving, with prompt observability.
MCP servers connecting internal data sources to LLM clients: models consume tools without bespoke glue code.
Brought MLOps practices into the team: retrieval evaluation, prompt and model versioning.

fullstack.title: Fullstack Developer
achievements: Desktop apps in .NET and Python for the shop floor, running 24/7.
Internal web apps with .NET and DevExpress for operations workflows.
Database design and administration on SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
Android app with RFID reader for field inventory and traceability.
